name: chatnova
description: ChatNova - WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram automation platform for Meta lead ads

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @chatnova/api" "npm run dev -w @chatnova/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chatnova/api && npm run build -w @chatnova/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chatnova/api && npm run typecheck -w @chatnova/web
